releaseNotes: Added automatic WebView disk-cache invalidation on version upgrades (LOAD_NO_CACHE + clearCache(true)) so newly installed APK updates always render immediately without serving cached assets.

Added first-time setup prompt to set KP TV as the device's default Home Launcher (using Android RoleManager.ROLE_HOME on Android 10+ and HOME intent chooser / Home Settings fallback), plus a Set as Default Launcher button in Settings.

Guaranteed default and installed app icons are always visible in the Bottom Dock and App Drawer with native https://kptv.local/app-icon/<packageName>.png streaming, 96x96 PNG data URLs, and automatic vector/brand icon badge fallbacks.
Enhanced AppDrawerModal D-pad focus management with pre-focus viewport bounds checking and smooth scrollTo animations.
